pad_anchor.basis: k = series(k_lat, kappa K A) (series), = k_t,L1 (l1_kt), series with (c A + N_design tan phi) / K_J (janosi); k_lat = 1 / (1/k_t,L1 - 1/k_concrete); c_t = c_t,L1 sqrt(k / k_t,L1), input c_t / 2 (R7); limit c A min(1, N / N_c) + N tan phi (5.33.7)

actuator.type: ChLinkMotorLinearForce, explicit force law (hook after each step)

saturation.law: C (judged force = force-law value, no rod-inertia term)

rod_side.law: moving k2(s) c + R0 exp(-(t - t_rel)/tau); locked F_lock + k2 dc + (k1 - k2) min(dc, dc_knee), k_h and k_r frozen at s_lock (dyn rev. 33 5.20.2)

valve.integration: exact exponential per step, leg speed = step mean (s6 spec 148 R-2)

s8.law: F = k_out (s_p - s) + c (u - ds), k_out (s_p - s) = G(s_ref - s_p) + f, |f| <= F_s (S8 spec 2.1 / 2.5); law C on F - f; stroke truth s_p

seal_friction.model: Coulomb, massless piston, parallel to the oil spring, series k_out (S8 spec 2.1); explicit return mapping per hook (2.5)

oil_law.law: moving k2(s) c + R0 exp(-(t - t_rel)/tau); locked F_lock + k2 dc + (k1 - k2) min(dc, dc_knee), k_h and k_r frozen at s_lock (dyn rev. 33 5.20.2)

rod_release.rule: moving leg: s_ref += A_ann (p_hat_prev - p_hat) / k_h(s_ref), both directions (v5 spec 2.3, D-4); p_hat = p_r + Delta w (revision 4), p_r = rod-side law value before the pressure floor

pressure_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(min(p_tr, p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0)), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)

lock_closure.rule: zero command: u = 0 once the step mean spool speed <= overlap_ratio v_max; lock closing_delay_s later; dashpot by the law's lock state (v5 spec 2.5)

departure.rule: crawler SCM normal < 0.01 W (3801 N) for 0.1 s (P3a-2, dynamics 5.36.5)

P3-1_crawler.criterion: SCM crawler normal sum = 0 in READY .. READY + 10 s; no recontact after the first departure

recontact_events.rule: U-S9-G6d + Q-G chatter: before the LOC, duration <= 0.5 s, ended before the LOC, max <= 0.15 W -> transient FLAG; after the LOC, start <= t_LOC + 1 s, duration <= 0.1 s, max <= 1.2 x limit, start < READY -> threshold_chatter FLAG (spec 423.3, = late_loc_rule.is_threshold_chatter); else strict fail

P3-2_loc.criterion: spec rev. 60, U-S9P-13 (가): crawler_liftoff_confirmed before the first DONE; no LOC while the crawler is loaded (normal >= 0.01 W at the LOC); LOC - departure <= T_lim = plateau_window_m / (push_speed_fraction v_max) + 1 s (ASSUMPTION tail share); the former <= 2 s clause is within_2s_record

loc_timeline.rule: spec 424.8.1: judged LOC = the first LOC after the last revocation (last confirmed LOC); a revocation cancels the latest LOC at / before it; revoked LOCs are records only

late_loc_reapproach.rule: spec 419.8 (decision 13, 2026-10-29): LOC - departure > T_lim is the FLAG P3-2_late_loc_reapproach when 1 a re-approach interval overlapping [t_off, t_LOC] had an LWa window restart (419.8.1), 2 t_LOC - max(t_off, t_re_end) <= T_lim (t_re_end = latest end of the overlapping intervals), 3 crawler true normal < 0.01 W over the LOC period, 4 P3-3 within and no FAULT, 5 LOC before the first DONE; else a failure

late_loc_revoked.rule: spec 424.8.1 (user decision 2026-10-29): LOC - departure > T_lim is the FLAG P3-2_late_loc_revoked when 1 a LOC revocation lies in [t_off, t_LOC^fin], 2 t_LOC^fin - max(t_off, t_revoke_last [, t_re_end when the 419.8 condition 1 holds]) <= T_lim, 3 crawler true normal < 0.01 W over the t_LOC^fin period, 4 P3-3 within and no FAULT, 5 t_LOC^fin before the first DONE, 6 (424.9) t_LOC^fin - t_off <= (1 + n_revoke) T_lim; else a failure

P3-3_leg_force.criterion: true F_cyl min after the departure >= F_min (9415 N); guard + 5 kN recorded; split at departure + 8 s (rev. 40 lift-off transient)

pre_liftoff_min_F_cyl.rule: min F_cyl from first > 1.4 F_min to the crawler departure; FLAG < F_min (9415 N), record only

creep_stop.rule: all pads: sinkage rate over 1 s < 0.1 mm/s (+ = deeper; t_*_two_sided_s: |rate|), after the crawler departure

P3-4_attitude.criterion: main judgement (control D-3, 2026-10-26): window [max(two-sided creep stop, last READY entry), t_end]; true attitude (quaternion roll / pitch, absolute, target 0) max |roll|, |pitch| <= 0.2 deg; window < 5 s -> window_short FLAG; no two-sided creep stop -> signed creep stop + creep_vibration_suspect FLAG; end 1 s values, dead band 0.03 deg, post-lift-off max <= 1 deg recorded; spec 433: sinkage rate over 1 s, window_short is not a pass

P3-5_clearance_stroke.criterion: spec rev. 60, U-S9P-14 (가): min rut clearance (10 Hz) from the first READY entry to the run end >= 25 mm (ASSUMPTION U-S9-C3); s_motor <= 0.6848 m; the minimum after the departure is within_after_departure_record
